snippet.title: Revenge On Gold Diggers is coming to console platforms
snippet.description: In the new year, continue to protect yourself and guard your love! The interactive FMV game Revenge On Gold Diggers, which has sold over 2 million copies in mainland China, is set to launch on February 14, 2026, for PS5, Xbox, and the Windows Store. This release will add Traditional Chinese language support and includes updated English localization. The game will simultaneously support Xbox Cloud Gaming and the Xbox Play Anywhere feature. A Nintendo Switch version will follow at a later date.
